stops.title: The Torah Map
stops.text: Every verse of the Tanakh — the Hebrew Bible's 23,000+ verses — is laid out here as a colored square. Torah on the right, Prophets in the middle, Writings on the left. Scroll down to explore.

stops.title: Abraham's Journey
stops.text: Abraham first appears in Genesis 12. Watch how his name lights up across the Torah — and then echoes through the Prophets and Writings.

stops.title: The Haftarah Portions
stops.text: Each week's Torah reading is paired with a passage from the Prophets. These pairings — the Haftarah — connect the Torah to the rest of the Bible.
